skill_name: What are the advantages of artificial neural networks over traditional computing methods?
workflow: One of the main advantages of artificial neural networks over traditional computing methods is their ability to learn from experience. Unlike traditional computing, neural networks can process a variety of inputs and respond accordingly, making them superior for complex tasks such as image and voice recognition.
